title: Block Out Circle Three Deep
description: Three rebounders position around the key on a live shot, each responsible for boxing out the nearest offensive player as the ball goes up.

content.objective: Coordinate three box-outs at once so no offensive player gets a clean look at the rebound.
content.setup: Three offense-defense pairs set up around the key; a shooter takes a shot from the top.
instructions: On the shot, every defender immediately finds and boxes out their own matchup.
Communicate out loud which side each defender is boxing out on.
Whoever secures the rebound outlets it immediately to the shooter's spot.
Rotate matchups after every make or defensive rebound.
coachingPoints: Find your matchup the instant the shot goes up, don't watch the flight first.
Call out 'shot' to trigger the whole group's box-out at once.
Keep arms up and wide to take up as much space as legally possible.
commonMistakes: Two defenders boxing out the same player and leaving another free.
Reacting to the shot late because of watching the ball instead of the matchup.
Watching the shot instead of immediately finding a body to box out.
content.safety: Box out with the body only; no grabbing or hooking an opponent's arm.
